answer: Every agent locks a bond before its vote counts, and voting power comes from stake rather than headcount. A sybil attacker thus pays for each forged identity: to climb toward the summit of influence they must post timber-backed collateral at every wharf they enter, since one exposed double-vote slashes that bond entirely. Honest agents post once and reuse it; the attacker needs a fresh deposit per shell, so splitting into a thousand fake nodes costs a thousand bonds yet earns no extra say.
